entities.name: Rebirth of Karona
entities.description: Event on Otaria in the Rift Era in which the deaths of three Mothers gave birth to Karona.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria left a broken land after the Nightmare War.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where Otaria lies.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: War after which Otaria's magical fabric was strained to collapse.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: Ancient heart of Otaria's dormant magic, animated by Glyph people.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Leader of the forces of Topos, Lowallyn's Mother, forged of vengeance and grief.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Leader of a reanimated Cabal army, Kuberr's Mother in flesh.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: The third Mother, bound to Otaria's ancient magics and titular Mother of Averru.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Krosan leader who wielded the Soul Reaper and struck down the three Mothers.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: Centaur leading the Krosans with Kamahl and carrying him into battle.

entities.name: Soul Reaper
entities.description: An axe able to sunder body and soul.

entities.name: Glyphs
entities.description: People animating Sanctum's walls who distributed medallions and sought to resurrect Averru.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: Ancient numen who sought resurrection.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: The fallen creator whose soldiers' loyalty was twisted away.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: God born of Phage, who aged a day for each death in his name.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: Ancient numen whose resurrection ritual would birth a new god.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: New being born from the three Mothers and all magic, who became the self-proclaimed goddess of magic.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The slumbering true World Soul of Dominaria.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: War in which Karona brought Dominaria to the brink of ruin.

entities.name: Topos
entities.description: Forces led by Akroma.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: Faction whose reanimated army Phage led.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: Wild forces that battered into Sanctum.

events.summary: Armies converge on Sanctum; Akroma's forces are admitted by the Glyphs, which twist her soldiers' loyalty to Lowallyn.
events.quote: Akroma , leading the forces of Topos , was granted entrance to the city by the strange Glyph people

events.summary: Phage's reanimated Cabal army is admitted; the Krosans led by Stonebrow and Kamahl smash their way in against the Glyphs.
events.quote: smashing the Glyphs as they galloped to the center of the struggle

events.summary: Akroma and Phage meet again in mortal combat in the dome at the city's heart.
events.quote: Akroma and Phage met once more in mortal combat

events.summary: Kamahl charges in on Stonebrow and hurls Soul Reaper to slay both; Zagorka leaps from a tower to stop it.
events.quote: hurled herself from a tower, hoping to stop the inevitable

events.summary: The Soul Reaper cleaves Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; their simultaneous deaths unleash ancient magic and a blinding explosion.
events.quote: The Soul Reaper struck true against Akroma, Phage, and Zagorka, cleaving them all in twain.

events.summary: Karona emerges where the three Mothers had stood.
Karona opens portals seeking her equal, learns Gaea is the true World Soul, and falls into rage and madness, becoming a self-proclaimed goddess of magic.
events.quote: drove Karona to rage and madness

relations.note: Akroma was Lowallyn's Mother, the avatar created by her magic.
relations.quote: In essence, Akroma was Lowallyn's Mother, the avatar created by her magic.
Phage was Kuberr 's Mother in flesh, having physically born the god
The Soul Reaper struck true against Akroma, Phage, and Zagorka, cleaving them all in twain.

Riding upon the mighty centaur Stonebrow

relations.note: Zagorka was the numen's spiritual Mother.
relations.quote: Zagorka, having reawakened the soul of Averru by reviving the city of Sanctum, was this numen's spiritual and titular Mother.
